title: Compute brief - 28 October 2026
description: Oracle will rent out Google TPUs from 2027, the first cloud outside Google to do so, and adds Cerebras alongside a multi-gigawatt Vera Rubin build. SK hynix posts 104.6 trillion won of quarterly revenue at an 80% operating margin and has more than half of 2027 and 2028 output under long-term contracts. Korea moves to cut unconfirmed AI data centre demand from its power plan. Tape: 68 confirms, 2 ticks (DigitalOcean AMD spot up), 0 NEW.
og_kicker: Oracle buys every kind of chip while the memory maker sells two years ahead
lede: The buyers are spreading their bets and the suppliers are locking in theirs. At Oracle AI World on Tuesday, Oracle said Google TPUs will be available on OCI in calendar 2027, the first time Google has put TPUs in another hyperscaler's cloud, and Cerebras inference is planned for OCI in 2027 as well. In the same hour Oracle and Nvidia said OCI will take Vera Rubin NVL72 to multi-gigawatt scale, on Oracle's own Acceleron networking with Spectrum-X; no deal value was given. On Wednesday SK hynix reported third-quarter revenue of 104.6 trillion won and operating profit of 83.3 trillion won, an 80% margin, said 2027 HBM volumes and prices are settled with major customers, and said long-term agreements with 14 customers cover more than half of its 2027 and 2028 capacity. Supply is being sold years forward at rising prices while demand is being split across more chip families. On the public tape, DigitalOcean lifted AMD spot back up: MI355X $2.97 to $4.50 and MI350X $2.46 to $3.00 per GPU-hour. The other 68 prints confirmed.
